fullPassage: In the course of trying to solve a problem with an invention, you may encounter a brick wall of resistance when you try to think your way logically through the problem. Such logical thinking is a linear type of process, which uses our reasoning skills. This works fine when we're operating in the area of what we know or have experienced. However, when we need to deal with new information, ideas, and viewpoints, linear thinking will often come up short. On the other hand, creativity by definition involves the application of new information to old problems and the conception of new viewpoints and ideas. For this you will be most effective if you learn to operate in a nonlinear manner; that is, use your creative brain. Stated differently, if you think in a linear manner, you'll tend to be conservative and keep coming up with techniques which are already known. This, of course, is just what you don't want.

questions.passage:
(A) She enrolled in an online <u>course</u> to learn graphic design over the summer vacation.
(B) In the <u>course</u> of trying to solve a problem with an invention, you may encounter a brick wall of resistance.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)에서 밑줄 친 course의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) 강좌/과목 — (B) 과정/진행: (A)는 그래픽 디자인을 배우는 '강좌', (B)는 'in the course of ~'로 '~하는 과정에서'라는 뜻으로 다의어의 두 의미를 올바르게 연결 ←정답
❌ ② (A) 과정 — (B) 강좌/과목: (A)는 online course로 강좌가 적절
❌ ③ (A) 강좌/과목 — (B) 항로: (B)의 course는 항로가 아닌 진행/과정
❌ ④ (A) 방향 — (B) 과정/진행: (A)는 방향이 아닌 강좌
det.tip: course: ① (명사) 강좌/과목 ② (명사) 과정/진행 (in the course of) ③ (명사) 항로

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a new device, method, or process that someone creates through experimentation"

det.korean: invention=발명(품) (실험을 통해 만들어 낸 새 장치/방법/과정)
det.analysis:
❌ ① resistance: resistance(저항)는 새로 만든 장치가 아님
✅ ② invention: invention(발명품)은 실험을 통해 만들어 낸 새 장치/방법으로 영영 정의에 정확히 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ viewpoint: viewpoint(관점)는 장치가 아닌 견해
❌ ④ definition: definition(정의)은 발명품과 무관
det.tip: invention = 발명(품). a problem with an invention이 본문 단서

questions.passage: This works fine when we're __________ (operate) in the area of what we know or have experienced. However, when we need to deal with new information, ideas, and viewpoints, linear thinking will often come up short.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.analysis: 'when we're (= we are) __________ in the area'에서 be동사 are 뒤에 현재진행형을 완성하는 현재분사가 필요. '~에서 작업하고 있을 때'라는 진행의 의미. operate → operating
det.tip: be동사 + V-ing = 현재진행형 (we're operating = 작업하고 있다)

questions.passage: Stated differently, if you think in a linear manner, you'll tend to be conservative and keep __________ (come) up with techniques which are already known.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.analysis: 'keep __________ up with'에서 동사 keep은 목적어로 동명사(V-ing)를 취한다. keep -ing = 계속 ~하다. come up with = ~을 생각해 내다. come → coming
det.tip: keep + V-ing = 계속 ~하다 (keep coming up with = 계속 떠올리다)

questions.passage: In the course of trying to solve a problem with an invention, you may encounter a brick wall of resistance when you try to think your way logically through the problem. Such logical thinking is a linear type of process, which uses our reasoning skills. This works fine when we're operating in the area of what we know or have experienced. However, when we need to deal with new information, ideas, and viewpoints, linear thinking will often __________. On the other hand, creativity by definition involves the application of new information to old problems and the conception of new viewpoints and ideas. For this you will be most effective if you learn to operate in a nonlinear manner; that is, use your creative brain. Stated differently, if you think in a linear manner, you'll tend to be conservative and keep coming up with techniques which are already known. This, of course, is just what you don't want.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: come up short=부족하다/미치지 못하다 — 새 정보를 다룰 때 선형 사고는 부족하다
det.analysis:
❌ ① work perfectly well(완벽히 작동한다): 새 정보를 다룰 때 선형 사고의 한계를 말하는 맥락과 반대
❌ ② save a lot of time(많은 시간을 절약한다): 글의 논지(한계)와 무관
❌ ③ solve every problem(모든 문제를 해결한다): 선형 사고의 한계와 반대
✅ ④ come up short(부족하다): 원문 일치. 새 정보·관점을 다룰 때 선형적 사고는 흔히 '부족하다'는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
det.tip: linear thinking will often come up short — 선형적 사고는 흔히 부족하다

questions.passage: In the course of trying to solve a problem with an invention, you may encounter a __________ when you try to think your way logically through the problem. Such logical thinking is a linear type of process, which uses our reasoning skills. This works fine when we're operating in the area of what we know or have experienced. However, when we need to deal with new information, ideas, and viewpoints, linear thinking will often come up short. On the other hand, creativity by definition involves the application of new information to old problems and the conception of new viewpoints and ideas. For this you will be most effective if you learn to operate in a nonlinear manner; that is, use your creative brain. Stated differently, if you think in a linear manner, you'll tend to be conservative and keep coming up with techniques which are already known. This, of course, is just what you don't want.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: brick wall of resistance=저항의 벽돌 벽 — 논리적으로만 생각할 때 부딪히는 한계
det.analysis:
❌ ① sudden burst of insight(갑작스러운 통찰): 저항/한계 맥락과 반대
❌ ② clear path forward(명확한 진전의 길): 벽에 부딪힌다는 맥락과 반대
✅ ③ brick wall of resistance(저항의 벽돌 벽): 원문 일치. 문제를 논리적으로만 생각하려 할 때 '저항의 벽'에 부딪힌다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ④ simple and quick solution(간단하고 빠른 해결책): 저항에 부딪힌다는 맥락과 반대
det.tip: encounter a brick wall of resistance — 저항의 벽돌 벽에 맞닥뜨리다
